## Checks

Automatic checks (secrets, CodeQL, dependency vulnerabilities and licences, tests) run on this pull request. Also:

- [ ] `/security-review` run, and every medium-or-higher finding fixed or explained
- [ ] Sign-in checked on any new page, server action or API route
- [ ] Personal data: nothing new collected or shared, **or** the privacy notice is updated (see `COMPLIANCE.md`)
- [ ] No new cookies or third-party tracking without consent
- [ ] New dependencies and assets have commercial-use licences
- [ ] Invoices, contracts and emails still show the required business details
